title: getPendingUpdateView request
description: GET /v1/engagements/{engagementId}/pending-update - request. Offer detail of one engagement: offer state (S3) + cumulative summary (S2, cell cache) + freshness. Serving a summary records SummaryViewed.v1 (view_outbox).
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (b) PendingUpdateView, (d) GetPendingUpdateDetailQuery, (e), (f) SummaryViewed.v1, (h), (i); DISENO 4.8 SX-01a, SX-01b; EV-28; PRD RF-035, RF-048, RF-050, RF-037. Audience: PUBLIC (served to the UI) - SX-01a + SX-01b caller. Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm, resolved by the stateless global edge firmId -> cell, RF-093); the firm comes from the authenticated context, never from the URL; summary content is global non-confidential, cached in the cell. Idempotency: read with an audit side effect: each served view emits one SummaryViewed.v1 with a fresh eventId (RF-048: every view counts). Pagination: none (single resource).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
